name: Pittsburgh videofluoroscopic swallow corpus (Sejdic, Coyle)
what: about 1,500 lateral swallow clips at 30 fps captured by video card, 265 patients and 70 volunteers on two machines
level_truth: thin: named corner points of C2, C3 and C4 (the antero-inferior corner of C2, the anterior-superior and anterior-inferior corners of C3 and C4), C3's on only the first three frames of each subject; no boxes, no other levels
